subject: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: John Morris <john.morris@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 2, 2028 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps

Hi John —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: you’re evaluating a private/VPC deployment for low-latency inference and stricter data controls across your payments service. Main asks were network architecture guidance, KMS integration, and SOC2 evidence for customer-managed environments.

Next step: we’d like to schedule a 60–90 minute architecture review + technical deep dive with our solutions engineering and infra teams (Marissa and Nikhil) and your infra/engineering leads. I’ve attached our architecture deck and a SOC2 summary that people find useful up front.

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Wed Apr 4 — 10:00–11:30 AM
- Thu Apr 5 — 2:00–3:30 PM
- Fri Apr 6 — 9:00–10:30 AM

If none of those work, please share 2–3 windows that work for your team and we’ll align calendars. Also confirm who from your side should attend (infra lead, security, and an SRE would be ideal).

Agenda we suggest:
1) Goals & constraints (5–10m)
2) Proposed VPC/on-prem topology and networking options (20–30m)
3) Key integrations: KMS/HSM, audit logs, and egress controls (20m)
4) Ops & runbook / HA targets + next steps (15–20m)

Calendly link if easier to pick a time: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-private-vpc-review

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

—
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-private-architecture-deck.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: John Morris <john.morris@fintechcorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 2, 2028 at 10:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps

Thanks, Aditya —

This works, appreciate the clear agenda. Sarah (cc’d) is our infra lead and will join — she’ll also pull in one of our SREs. Of the slots you proposed, Thu Apr 5 2:00–3:30 PM PDT looks best for our team.

A couple quick asks before the call:
- Can you include an example of the customer-managed KMS flow (high level)?
- Any pre-reqs for networking (vpc peering vs PrivateLink) we should prepare?

I’ll hold the slot on our calendar once you send the invite.

Thanks,
John
VP Engineering | FinTech Corp
john.morris@fintechcorp.com | +1 (646) 555-0987

John —

Great — Thu Apr 5 2:00–3:30 PM PDT is saved on our side. I’ll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link and include the agenda below. Marissa and Nikhil will own the technical walkthrough and can bring example topology diagrams + a sample runbook.

We’ll cover the KMS flow and networking pre-reqs in the technical section; quick notes so you have them before the call:
- KMS: we support BYOK via customer KMS with envelope encryption; we’ll walk through the handshake and key rotation cadence on the call.
- Networking: options are VPC peering (lower latency, more routing control) or PrivateLink (managed endpoint, simpler NAT/egress control). We’ll show trade-offs for cross-region traffic.

I’ve attached the deck again and added a short runbook draft to the shared folder. If Sarah or the SRE has any specific network diagrams to share beforehand, feel free to drop them in the Drive link.

Invite and drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4D-redwood-fintech-arch

—
Aditya
